# Lumina Digitale
> Lumina Digitale is a software and digital services studio offering web and mobile development, workflow automation, e-commerce consulting, SEO, security checks and practical training.

Lumina Digitale was founded by Taha Bayar in 2024. Kionel, GamersPilot, CarQR and Skater are Lumina Digitale products. Namera Academy is client development work; the client owns its brand and product. Mori and Mergeverse are in development/testing, not publicly released. Crypto-related research is currently backtesting and paper trading; live execution is not implemented.
